summary: 59-year-old woman suffered a possible sprained ankle on the Diamond Lake Trail in the Indian Peaks Wilderness; carried out on a litter to the Fourth of July Trailhead; declined hospital transport and left with friends.
location: Diamond Lake Trail, Indian Peaks Wilderness
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Nederland Fire/Rescue; Boulder County Sheriff's Office
notes: Boulder Weekly police blotter (opened run 441). Blotter issue is July 2010 (Rosinski July-16 item pins the year; search-index Last-Updated is a migration artifact). Report received July 15 ~12:25 p.m.; patient conscious; rescuers offered ambulance transport, declined.
